```
[Intro]
Heavy wind rattles the windowpane
The brass dial ticks, but the time feels strange
A shadow moves where the light should be
The keeper knows the silence isn't free

[Verse 1]
The lantern hums a low, electric tune
While frost creeps up the hallway floor and moon
The clock hands spin but refuse to align
With the rhythm of the falling winter pine
He opens up the cedar door with care
And finds a tiny gear inside the air
It spins alone, a silver, silent ghost
Before the heavy winter's final test
The signal calls from out the sea
A lighthouse beam cuts through the grey
A warning for the ships at rest
Or maybe just a signal for the dead
To wake up from the frozen bed

[Chorus]
Oh, the gear that learned to mourn
The clock beneath the moon
Keeps time for footsteps in the snow
But the snow is not the only thing that grows
A tiny heart inside the brass
Beating out a rhythm, not a pass
The lighthouse calls from across the shore
But the keeper hears a door that opens more

[Verse 2]
The next morning brings a thawing rain
The gear has left the cedar door again
It floats on puddles in the hall
A silver ship upon a watery wall
The keeper watches it drift away
While the clock ticks out a different day
The signal changes pitch and tone
No longer calling from the stone
It's singing now a melody of loss
As the gears inside the clock begin to toss
They grind together, a chaotic sound
Like thunder rolling through the ground
The brass observatory shakes and groans
As the tiny gear finds its own bones

[Chorus]
Oh, the gear that learned to mourn
The clock beneath the moon
Keeps time for footsteps in the snow
But the snow is not the only thing that grows
A tiny heart inside the brass
Beating out a rhythm, not a pass
The lighthouse calls from across the shore
But the keeper hears a door that opens more

[Verse 3]
The rain turns back to snow again
The gear has stopped, it's done its pen
It sits now in the clock's deep chest
A memory of the moment of the test
The keeper closes up the door
And leaves the tiny gear to roar
Inside the brass, it spins once more
But now it's not a ghost, it's not a war
It's a friend who learned to say goodbye
And watch the world beneath the sky
The lighthouse beam is gone from view
But the gear still shines, a silver hue

[Outro]
The clock beneath the moon
Keeps time for footsteps in the snow
The tiny gear is gone, but not alone
It lives inside the brass, and so we know
The lighthouse on the shore
Is just a memory, a ghost, a door
The keeper walks away, the lantern low
The gear has learned to mourn, and now it knows
The clock beneath the moon
Keeps time for footsteps in the snow
```
